scope: Western-centered AI compute, funding and hardware network; selected global suppliers. Not a global AI industry census.
scope_notes: Whole-parent cash is relevant to solvency, but retail, advertising, Office and space revenues must not be labeled AI end demand.
No claim of improper accounting follows from these relationships.
Thirty-two company/group references are a seed map, not a quantified 95 percent sample.
gaps: Global coverage: ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu and other regional networks not quantified.
Additional developers/hosts/landlords including Mistral, Cohere, Crusoe, IREN and others require tracing.
Debt holders, managed funds, SPVs and lease assignees often cannot be allocated to a named ultimate counterparty.
No complete matrix of settled bilateral cash, recognition timing, receivables/payables or internal asset margins.
Announcements, future contract values, financing capacity and reported investments use different bases/periods.
Corporate pages were reviewed retrospectively; publication availability is not a complete contemporaneous website archive.
